titles.romaji: THE MOON: Tsuki ga Hoshii to Oujo-sama ga Naita
titles.english: The King's Daughter Cries for the Moon
titles.native: THE MOON-月がほしいと王女さまが泣いた

description: The story centers on a princess who wishes to reach the Moon. Her journey and resulting disappearance raise clamor and chaos throughout the royal palace and among the creatures of the kingdom.
